# Vendored libraries

Copied unmodified from their releases. Update by replacing the files and noting the version here.

| Library | Version | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signalsmith Stretch | 1.4.0 | https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch | MIT (`signalsmith-stretch/LICENSE.txt`) |
| Signalsmith Linear | 0.6.4 | https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear | MIT (`signalsmith-linear/LICENSE.txt`) |

Only the headers are used. Built with `SIGNALSMITH_USE_ACCELERATE` so FFTs go through Apple's Accelerate framework.
